Jano' ba' gu vaak gu Jerusalem gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa ka't na ja'p pai' gu Topet guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu vaak bhaan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tɨkɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jeremiiyas gu Topet pai' bhañ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Miren tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan dhi' kiicham bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨx cham bhai' tu ñi'ook bhaan; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Pasur jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu mar gu Immer guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jix kai gu Jeremiiyas guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios dhi' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' naaka'n gu Pasur gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jix dhaas guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios ka't ki'ñgob gu Benjamiin guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh buimgidhak gu Pasur jix buusñi gu Jeremiiyas guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jeremiiyas; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' tɨɨgim gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Pasur guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Magor-missabib.

Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu' bɨx xoi'kam tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu vupui guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu Judaa kapbhai' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia bhaan gu Babiloonia guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' kapbhai' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios dhi' kiicham bɨx tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x a'bhar; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨx guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu noobh guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Babiloonia.

Jano' ba' tu' gu Pasur bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ba'k gu Babiloonia koi ka' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu' bɨx xoi'kam tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix kavɨk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr gu tanoolh guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu'.

Na gu' na gu' dɨr chɨɨdaim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jiiñak guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Biolenkia chajaañ; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu tɨɨgɨ'; gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn ka't gu i'ii'ñ na ja'p gu tai guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam o'oo guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu jiim cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Na gu' na gu' tu' vaak jodai mui'x choo'n guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; mi' dhɨr bɨx guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ am:―Ja'pji guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bhaan guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ja'p gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; na gu' ka't guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na gu' cham jix duu; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ mɨɨjidha' ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jir bhai' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; na gu' tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn kuiñcha.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu' gu i'ii'ñ gampai' gu novɨ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' gu Maldito gu tanoolh guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; gio ba' gu tanoolh gu naan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam cham ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu chio'ñ jix maa guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu taat bham gu mar gu chio'ñ tu' maaxir guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu jiim jix jai'.

Jano' ba' ka't tu jiim gu chio'ñ na ja'p jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios cham guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu xibh jiiñak tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh.
Na gu' na gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ vook gu naan guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tukga'n vook guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa vook na ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu tanoolh guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook ka't gu Jeremiiyas gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk gu gɨ'kora' gu Sedekîas bhañ gu Pasur gu mar gu Malkîas gu Sepaniias jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu mar gu Maasiias tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook jano' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm no'ch gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan no'ch; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨɨx no'ch bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kɨɨ'p guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan no'ch.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jeremiiyas; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Sedekîas.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham gu noobh bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia; mi' dhɨr gu Kaldeos namki' mia'n mai' vaak jodai tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' kiicham.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx gu novɨ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk bɨɨx i'iich guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' kiicham; gio ba' gu chichio'ñ gu vaakax guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix gɨ'.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios kapbhai' gu Sedekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ kiicham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhiogi' gu novɨ gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu novɨ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' jix duu guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu kuchii; mi' dhɨr cham uañi'ñka' tu' makia' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch.

Jano' ba' dhi' gu ja'tkam daipu'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam vupui bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu bhóogɨt gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt koi'm.

Na guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' kiicham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhiogi' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Kaldeos namki' mia'n ii'mdagaram gu oidha' ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Na gu' na gu' gu vupui guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bhaan dhi' kiicham na ba' cham bhai' cham na ba' xoi'kam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia ka't kapbhai' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu tai.
Jano' ba' gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa daipu'; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu vaak gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu xibh ñi'ook na jir bhai' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu novɨ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga na ja'p gu tai guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ cham ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' na cham jir bhai' buimɨi.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' bhaan tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu jodai guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr chɨkka guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan no'ch chɨkka guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jurtu'nka' gu i'bhɨ buimɨi tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix duu gu tai guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨx xikoolh.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa tu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tu'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam daakat bhaan atooxkor gu Dabii tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ja'tkam ba'k guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' kiki'ñgob.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨx bhai' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu novɨ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ja'tkam mii' dhɨr tu' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam tu' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ɨ'ɨr guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ dhi' pai'.

Na gu' na gu' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam dhi' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' pai' gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bhaan atooxkor jɨjɨkgɨm gɨ' kavɨk guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kiki'ñgob dhi' gu vaak guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ja'tkam.
Gu' gu' tu' cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ dhi' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios dhi' gu vaak ka't oidha' jix gaki.

Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jix duu tu' na ba' tu' mo'o gu Liibano; gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tɨɨda' tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.
Jano' ba' nɨi'ñchudat bhaan tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm maa'n bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu tai.

Jano' ba' mumua'da' chɨbɨɨp guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ ju'ñdharan dhi' kiicham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ maa'n duiñchu'; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix duu gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx dhi' jix gɨ' kiicham.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios o'lhia gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix koi tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu'; na gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ mɨɨjidha' tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu oidha' pai' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Sallum gu mar gu Josiiyas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Josiiyas gu taat jix buus dhi' pai'; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' va'k guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam pai' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ dhi' gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu vaak cham bɨx bhai' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ cham ñi'ook na jir bhai' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tɨtmo guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tu jiim.

Na tu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios na ba' tu' gu vaak guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gɨ' u'u kavɨk guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na gu' tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gɨ' u'u kavɨk cham jix jugi jix i'i gu taat tu' ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨx bhai' jano' ba' ka't xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa kuiñcha gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam jano' ba' juruuñ xoi'kam; gio ba' cham dhi' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Gu' gu' gu vupui gu i'ii'ñ cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ɨ'ɨr guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Joakim gu mar gu Josiiyas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bham; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook xibhɨk guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bham; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn buur ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam mai' kiki'ñgob gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' tu jiim gu Liibano duuñ gu Basaan jix maa gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; na gu' bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; jano' ba' dhi' ka't gu bhóogɨt dɨr guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' bɨx bipia'dam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu jɨvɨl guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam kuiñcha bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Liibano guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ na pai' dhuuk tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na ja'p gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu Koniias gu mar gu Joakiim gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa jum duu guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu novɨ kɨɨ'n guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' tu' kapbhai' gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu i'ii'ñ gu novɨ mii' dhɨr ja'tkam ñiata guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; gio ba' gu novɨ gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia gu novɨ gu Kaldeos.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bhaan tu' gu naan tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu oidha' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; gio ba' koi.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu i'ii'ñ na ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' dhi' gu chio'ñ gu Koniias guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios vaaso bɨɨx soo'mchulhdhak guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Por guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix duu guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu oidha' cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' pai' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios ka't dhi' gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix duu gu chio'ñ cham tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha'; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu chio'ñ gu kai' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan atooxkor gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhaan gu Judaa ka't mɨɨjidha' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bipia'dam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga kakneer guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel bipia'dam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ kakneer guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' na cham jir bhai' buimɨi tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios kakneer guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan bipia'dam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jupaabkamu'n gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Dabii guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jir bhai' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu gɨ'kora' ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨx bhai' gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Judaa tu' gu Israeel guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' dhi' ka't gu tɨɨgɨ' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios bɨx bhai' gu Nuestra.

Na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jupaabkamu'n gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios jix duu guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu oidha' gu Ejipto.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios jix duu guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu kai' gu vaak gu Israeel gu oidha' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios ka't tu' baas; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' kuiñcha jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' bɨx o'oo guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ja'p gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na ja'p gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm suudai' u'va vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.

Na gu' na gu' gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix duu; na gu' kuiñcha guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu oidha' pai' jix gaki; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn pai' jix gaki guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu kavɨk cham jix duu.

Na gu' na gu' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan na ja'p jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu vaak gu ñi'ook tu' na cham jir bhai' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam na ja'p jix duu gu tukgam ka't gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; na gu' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ cham bhai' bhaan oidha' tas guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Samaria buupui guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Baal tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jerusalem buupui guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu jiim guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu noobh tomaat na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; mi' dhɨr jix bɨɨx duu bɨx na ja'p gu Sodoma guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na ja'p gu Gomorra.

Na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ bhaan mii' dhɨr ja'tkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jugi guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ i'i gu suudai' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; na gu' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jerusalem jix buus guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan bɨx gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ñi'ook jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; mi' dhɨr xoi'kam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; jano' ba' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu i'ii'ñ cham gu chin gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr bhai'x i'ii'ñ gui'x; jano' ba' no'x guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu i'ii'ñ gui'p; gio ba' cham ɨlhdham cham bhai' bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.
Na gu' na gu' chɨkka juruuñ ɨxchuixim gu Jawatan Dios jix ñi' jix kai gu ñi'ook chɨkka juruuñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu ñi'ook jix kai.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx i'iich; gio ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhaan mo'o tomaat.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa i'iich gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' kuugalhdha' gu tanoolh kaaya' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' cham tu jiim tu' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' tu' cham tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn dhi' ɨxchuixim gio guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ cham bhai' gu bhóogɨt tu' na cham jir bhai' buimɨi.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham gu Jawatan Dios jix jai' tu'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam oi'ñdha' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' cham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' tu' naak mii' dhɨr ja'tkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gui'p guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu tɨɨgɨ' bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm duuk ka't dhi' gu i'ii'ñ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam iatda' gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' bɨx bhaan gu Judaa gu Babiloonia guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam mu'ai bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu Sedekîas na ja'p gu Akâb guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu tai gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia.

Na gu' na gu' jix duu tu' na cham jir bhai' gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ñi'ookdham tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Semaiias gu Neelam tu ñi'ook bham.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel bham; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Jerusalem gu Soponiias jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu mar gu Maasiias bɨx jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bham.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan pai' gu Joiada jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios bhaan bɨx gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham jano' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jeremiiyas gu Anatot guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.

Na gu' na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bhañ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Babiloonia; gio ba' tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu vaak guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu i'bhɨ.
Jano' ba' gu Soponiias jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ka't jiñkai'ñ dhi' gu ñi'ook maatɨt gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jeremiiyas bham.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Semaiias gu Neelam; na gu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Semaiias tu' cham tu jiim jix duu guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Miren tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bhaan gu Semaiias gu Neelam bhaan jix duu; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' gu ja'tkam tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn mii' dhɨr xoi'kam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu Jeremiiyas gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat u'uan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook.

Na gu' na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jupaabkamu'n gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ja'tkam gu Israeel gu Judaa tu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu oidha' tu' tattat guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.
Ba' jix aa' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Israeel gu Judaa.
Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ naak gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn cham bhai'x i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook jano' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu chio'ñ; na gu' buupui bɨx gu chio'ñ ga'ra' gu noobh bhaan guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na ja'p gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix gɨ' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam cham cham tu'x jai'ch nɨidhim; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ na ba' gu Jakob; gu' ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn baakux guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ juantu'n.
Gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Jawatan Dios gu Dabii gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Jano' ba' tu' tu duukam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jakob cham jum i'obh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Israeel; na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu kai' gu oidha' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; mi' dhɨr gu Jakob guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Na gu' na gu' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨndak tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' dodhia'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ chɨbɨɨp tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr tu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨɨx ñi'ook na jir bhai' cham tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨx.
Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu jiim.
Jano' ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam kuiñcha na ba' tulhiiñdha'; gio ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch na ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' cham tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; na gu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bhaamki'ñdha' tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu ñi'ook kuiñcha guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' na cham jir bhai' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam uañi'ñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam kuiñcha guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Desaukiado guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' na cham jir bhai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mui'x uañi'ñ tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam dhi'.

Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨx tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; gio ba' bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨx guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga ka't tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨx jix duu guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Gu' gu' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na ba' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu Arrojada tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bham; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu Sioon soo'mchulhdhak tu jiim.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios vaak zel gu Jakob vaak zel guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch; mi' dhɨr kiicham ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhaan duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhai' ñi'ook gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam xoi'kam; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ cham ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ cham ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ma'nkam na ja'p maa'n guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ vupui bhaan tu' ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨx guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' ka't jix kavɨk tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam mia'n guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu'; na gu' chɨkka mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu i'ii'ñ na ba' jix duu tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' boopoya' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ja'tkam tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨɨx i'iich guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' bhaan mo'o guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ka'm ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu tanoolh kaaya' dhi'.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios bɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Israeel ka't tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook nɨidhidha' oidha' jix gaki gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jiimchu' tu' na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ñi'ook jɨɨpi'ñka' gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu' jix jai' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu' bham; gio ba' bɨɨx xoi'kam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' dha'; na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨɨx xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios ka' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨɨx tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu kakkavɨk gu Samaria; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jix duu kua'dam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Na gu' na gu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook nuuka'n gu kavɨk gu Epraim; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Sioon gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.

Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Jakob bɨɨx bhai' ñi'ook guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jiiñak guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa mo'o chɨbɨɨp; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios ja'xñi; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios dodhia' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu oidha' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu oidha' tɨjɨɨ'ñ ñiññia mama'mkulhi' gu u'vɨ gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨɨma'n; gio ba' jix gɨ' chu'p guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx suanda' gu' bɨɨx i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ju'ñdharan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu suudai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt jix duu cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; na gu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu taat gu Epraim maa'nkam mar.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook chɨbɨɨp guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn maachim guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ja'xñi; na guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na ja'p bipia'dam gu vaakax.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jakob guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix kavɨk.

Jano' ba' aajim jix duu bhai' ñi'ook guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Sioon guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu' gu vaakax kakneer guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ ka't na ja'p u'uu pai' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam nu'aa' bɨɨma'n; gio ba' suanda' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga ka't gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam xoi'kam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Ramaa guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ suanda' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; na gu' gu Rakêl guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu ma'nkam na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu vupui suakɨt; na gu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ cham tu'x jai'ch na ba' tu duukam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu oidha' bhaamki'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' nɨɨra gio cham tu'x jai'ch na ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios naak gu Epraim guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ na ja'p guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; na gu' tu' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios.

Na gu' na gu' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tɨtdaidha' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; na gu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na gu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' cham gu Epraim gu mar guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios na ba' tu' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dɨr tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ba'k guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' dhi' buimɨk guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' jix duu guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm pai' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Israeel guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ dhi' jɨ'dɨlh.

Na gu' bɨɨx ka'm duuk guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ na gu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan gu oidha'; gio ba' gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu chio'ñ.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ dhi' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Judaa jɨ'dɨlh na pai' dhuuk tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ñi'ook gu vaak na jix bhaiꞌ bɨx bhai' gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Judaa gio guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh uubas guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx kakneer.
Na gu' na gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨx gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jupaabkamu'n gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu vaak gu Israeel gu vaak gu Judaa gu kai' gu chio'ñ gu kai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh cham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' tattat koi'mɨk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ma'nkam namki' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' na cham jir bhai'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨx gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jupaabkamu'n gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix vɨɨk ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu vaak gu Jakob bɨɨx gu vaak gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' cham na ja'p ñi'ook na jix bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx tattat gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu novɨ na ba' jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto; na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn ñi'ook na jix bhaan xoi'kam tu jiim tu' gu chio'ñ na ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Gu' gu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ñi'ook na jix bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨɨx gu vaak gu Israeel mi' dhɨr mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ñi'ook na tu a'ga ba'k ua'na' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tɨtmo tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ xibhɨk bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' bɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn dɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix ali' bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix gɨ' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios tu' na cham jir bhai' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ uañi'ñ.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix maa gu tas na ba' gu tasi' gu tanoolh ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu masad gu si'avag na ba' gu tasi' gu tukaa'; na baasɨ'n gu gɨ' suudai' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu tɨɨgɨ'.

Jano' ba' tu' dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ vupui bhaan tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gio gu kai' gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ na ba' cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ja'tkam vupui bhaan tu' bɨx gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu tɨkɨr jiix jɨ'xdha' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu oidha' gio tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨx gu kai' gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx jix duu tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jupaabkamu'n gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios kiicham ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios dɨr bhi'ñbak gu ananeel bɨɨx ka'm ki'ñgob guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan bhaan guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu areb guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Goa.

Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu chuukug koko'kam maatai guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Kedroon bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ki'ñgob guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tas buusñi ka't jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na ba' bɨɨx tas.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu Jeremiiyas gu Jawatan Dios oidha' tas guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Sedekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa ka't oidha' tas guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Nabukodonosor.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia ga'ra' mia'n gu Jerusalem; gio ba' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jeremiiyas ka't kuupka' naadat kuupa' ka't gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.

Na gu' gu Sedekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa ka't kuupka' bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu' bham; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' kapbhai' dhi' kiicham gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Jano' ba' gu Sedekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu novɨ gu Kaldeos guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tɨɨda' ka't dhagia' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia tu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu chin gu vupui guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu vupui.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Sedekîas gu Babiloonia guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx ka'm tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨɨx gu Kaldeos cham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ xoi'kam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jeremiiyas; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu' bham.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu anameel gu mar gu Sallum guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jupaabkamu'n tu' bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu maa'nkar gu Anatot; na gu' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix duu na ba' tu jiim.

Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va tu' gu anameel gu mar guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios naadat kuupa'; na gu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jano' gu maa'nkar gu Anatot gu oidha' gu Benjamiin na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix duu guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn na ba' tu'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu maa'nkar gu anameel gu mar guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ka't gu Anatot guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tuumiñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix toja jodai.

Jano' ba' ua'ñ gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tuumiñ bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bhaan jix duu guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bhaan jix kupi'ook.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jupaabkamu'n gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook jix bhai' gu vaak gu Israeel gu vaak gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Dabii gu Pimpollo bɨx bhai' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨx bhai' gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh gu Judaa ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ dhi' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx bhai' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.
Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Dabii gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan atooxkor gu vaak gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu maa'nkar bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jeremiiyas bham.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨɨx gu tanoolh guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨɨx gu tukaa' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm cham ka't gu tanoolh tu' gu tukaa' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gio guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx tu duukam gu Dabii na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam mambhɨɨx gu mar gu gɨ'kora' bhaan atooxkor bɨɨx gu Lebitas jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' na ja'p cham jɨ'xdha' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tɨkɨr tu' oo' gu gɨ' suudai' jɨ'xdha' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu kai' gu Dabii tu duukam gu Lebitas tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jeremiiyas bham.

Jano' ba' cham baas guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam bham; gio ba' gook guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka'm cham jix xoi'kam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨɨx gu tanoolh gu tukaa' tu' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu tɨkɨr gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gio guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu kai' gu Jakob gu Dabii tu duukam na ba' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu kai' ka't gu Jawatan bhaan gu kai' gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Jakob; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch.

Na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook ka't gu Jeremiiyas gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu oidha' aapi' gu novɨ bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu Jerusalem bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh bham.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Sedekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kapbhai' tu' dhi' kiicham gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx gu tai.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' gu novɨ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tɨɨda' ka' kuupka' gu novɨ ka' dhagia'; gio ba' gu vupui guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu vupui gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia tu' tu ñi'ook gu chin gu Babiloonia ba'k.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Sedekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu'; mi' dhɨr cham koi guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ koi jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tattat gu gɨ'kora' dharka' jix bɨɨx duu va'k tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan; na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Sedekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu Jerusalem bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhaan gu Lakîs bhaan gu Aseka; na gu' jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk gu Judaa guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook ka't gu Jeremiiyas gu Jawatan Dios mi' dhɨr gu Sedekîas guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨɨx bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Jerusalem na ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Na maa'n guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tu duukam maa'n ja'tkam na tu juan guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; na guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Judiios gu ja'tkam na ja'p tu duukam.

Jano' ba' na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨx chiñia' bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tɨbiap guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn maa'n tu duukam maa'n ja'tkam na tu juan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na ja'p tu duukam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.

Gu' gu' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu duukam ja'tkam na tu juan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tɨtda:―Cha'pim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ja'tkam na tu juan.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jeremiiyas baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios bham.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx tattat gu tanoolh guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu vaak tu duukam bham.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam kɨɨv guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ maa'n xibhɨk guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu' ua'tulhi'ñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim namkidhat tu'; gu' tattat cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios naak.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat dua'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jix duu vupui bhaan gu vupui aa'ñdhim maa'n guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tɨtmo; gio ba' dua'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu vaak bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu tɨɨgɨ'.

Gu' gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu tɨɨgɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam maa'n tu duukam maa'n ja'tkam na tu juan dua'ñ tɨtda:―Cha'pim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat aagak; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix duu tu duukam ja'tkam na tu juan.

Na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ naak guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam maa'n guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios xibhɨk maa'n duiñchu'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bhiogi'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' kapbhai' gu chichio'ñ bhaan ñi'ook na jix bhaan cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ baabuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jix bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gook guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tuur bhɨi guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' chiñia' gu Judaa chiñia' gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tuur.
Jano' ba' kapbhai' gu novɨ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu chuukug koko'kam ka't na ba' jugi gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr gu vaakax gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu Sedekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa chiñia' kapbhai' gu novɨ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu i'ii'ñ gu novɨ ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' kiicham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tai; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa bɨɨx ka'm cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu Jeremiiyas gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh gu Joakim gu mar gu Josiiyas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa bham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu vaak gu Rekâbitas tu ñi'ook bɨɨx tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jix duu guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn i'i suudai' u'va.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jano' ba' gu Jaasaniias gu mar gu Jeremiiyas gu mar gu abassiniias gu ja'tkam bɨx gu ma'nkam bɨx ja'tkam vaak gu Rekâbitas.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam gu anaan gu mar gu Igdaliias gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't ju'ñdharan guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam chiñia' ka't bhaan guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Maasiias gu mar gu Sallum jix nukadham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam ja'tkam vaak gu Rekâbitas guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios jaja' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios suudai' u'va guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam suudai' u'va.

Gu' gu' gui'p; gio ba' cham i'i suudai' u'va; na gu' gu Jonadab gu mar gu Rekâb chulhiiñdha' gu taat jix aa'ñdhix bham; jano' ba' cham i'i mɨɨjidha' suudai' u'va guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' gu ma'nkam.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu vaak tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ oidha' u'va tu' gui'x; gu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ vaak zel bɨx gu tanoolh na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam mui'x gu tanoolh bhaan gu vupui gu oidha' pai' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' no'ch guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ñi'ook gu Jonadab chulhiiñdha' gu taat gu mar gu Rekâb guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x jix aa'ñdhix cham i'i suudai' u'va bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu tanoolh no'ch tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu u'vɨ tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ma'nkam tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak na ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu vaak na jix bhaiꞌ cham mambhɨɨx oidha' u'va tu' gu maa'nkar tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga vaak zel guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x jix aa'ñdhix gu Jonadab chulhiiñdha' gu taat.

Na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn na pai' dhuuk gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia jix tɨ'ɨ gu oidha' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duu guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jerusalem vupui bhaan ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Kaldeos vupui bhaan ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Siria; mi' dhɨr gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jeremiiyas bham.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' gu chio'ñ gu Judaa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jerusalem; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jonadab gu mar gu Rekâb jix aa'ñdhix gu ma'nkam cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ suudai' u'va cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu ñi'ook gu taat; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn a'gi'ñchu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ naak.

Jano' ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨx tu duukam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jano' maa'n cham bhai' gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam buimɨi cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ na ba' tu duu duaka' gu oidha' tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tattat; gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ naak tu' ja'pni.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Jonadab gu mar gu Rekâb chooto'n guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook jix maa gu taat; gu' dhi' gu ja'tkam cham tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' bhaan gu Judaa bhaan bɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jerusalem bɨx cham bhai' bhaan tu ñi'ook; na gu' tu ñi'ook cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jeremiiyas ja'tkam vaak gu Rekâbitas; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; na gu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu ñi'ook gu Jonadab gu taat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨx gu ñi'ook tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x jix aa'ñdhix.

Na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu chio'ñ gu Jonadab gu mar gu Rekâb guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' ka't maakobh oidha' tas gu Joakim gu mar gu Josiiyas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa ka't dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Jeremiiyas gu Jawatan Dios bham.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat u'uan ua'ñxidha' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook bhaan gu Israeel bhaan gu Judaa bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ chɨbɨɨp dɨr gu tanoolh kua'da' dɨr gu tanoolh gu Josiiyas bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu vaak gu Judaa bɨx cham bhai' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu jiim na ba' jix joi'ñ maa'n cham bhai' gu bhóogɨt tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios tu' na cham jir bhai' uañi'ñ.

Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Jeremiiyas gu Baruk gu mar gu Neriias ua'na gu Baruk gu chin gu Jeremiiyas guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat u'uan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix aa'ñdhix gu Jeremiiyas gu Baruk bham; gio ba' tu' dhi' kuupka' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ baakɨi gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' ba'k tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam dhi' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu chin gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios maatɨt gu ja'tkam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gio maatɨt bɨx gu Judaa jupaabkamu'n jɨ'dɨlh.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam soi'm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam maa'n cham bhai' gu bhóogɨt; na gu' jix gɨ' i'iich guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios bhaan dhi' gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Baruk gu mar gu Neriias jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x jix aa'ñdhix gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam u'uan gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' ka't oidha' tas jixchamaam gu Joakim gu mar gu Josiiyas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Jerusalem bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' gu Baruk ñi'ook na tu a'ga u'uan gu ñi'ook gu Jeremiiyas gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Gemariias gu mar gu Sapaan guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jiix ba'k ki'ñgob guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios maatɨt gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Mikêas gu mar gu Gemariias gu mar gu Sapaan dhaibu naak u'uan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix dhaav gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx chiñia' mi'p guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ maachim; gio ba' gu Elisama guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Delaiias gu mar gu Semeiias gu Elnataan gu mar gu Akbor gu Gemariias gu mar gu Sapaan gu Sedekîas gu mar gu Ananiias bɨx chiñia'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Mikêas guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook ka't naak guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Baruk u'uan maatɨt gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' mɨjɨ bɨx chiñia' gu Jeudii gu mar gu Netaniias gu mar gu Selemiias gu mar gu Kusi na ba' tu ñi'ook gu Baruk; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ maatɨt gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; mi' dhɨr gu Baruk gu mar gu Neriias jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu novɨ suudai' u'va.
Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' xanoop jano' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ maatɨt; mi' dhɨr ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Baruk maatɨt.

Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook maa'n guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ duiñchu' gui'p gu Baruk; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tɨkka gu Baruk bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jano' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu chin gu Jeremiiyas guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Baruk; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu chin guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' gu ñi'ook tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios u'uan.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gui'p chiñia' gu Baruk; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' gu Jeremiiyas soo'mchulhdhak guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim duukat.

Jano' ba' baap gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ dhaibu guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Elisama guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam maatɨt gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' bhañ gu gɨ'kora' gu Jeudii guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Elisama guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jeudii maatɨt gu gɨ'kora' maatɨt bɨx chiñia' ju'ñdharan gu gɨ'kora' mi'p.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' ka't gu vaak guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn ka't gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ vupui bhaan.

Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p gu Jeudii ka't jiñkai'ñ vaik maakobh guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu tai ka't gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm bɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhaan gu tai gu ñi'ook ka't.
Jano' ba' cham chooto'n choo'n tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jajannulhi'ñ gu gɨ'kora' bɨx tu duukam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Elnataan gu Delaiias gu Gemariias guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu gɨ'kora' cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' va'k jix aa'ñdhix gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerameel gu mar gu Amelek gu Seraiias gu mar gu Asriel gu Selemiias gu mar gu Abdeel guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Baruk guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; gu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jeremiiyas mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ñi'ook gu Baruk ka't ua'nak gu chin gu Jeremiiyas bham.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ua'ñxidha' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ñi'ook tumiiñku mi'p maa'n guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Joakim gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' daipu' gu Joakim gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ dhi' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bham; jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bham; gio ba' tɨɨda' ɨlhdham gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios dhi' gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu chichio'ñ tu' gu vaakax.

Na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Joakim gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan atooxkor gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug ka't baas guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu tukaa'.

Jano' ba' jix gɨ'kora' gu gɨ'kora' gu Sedekîas gu mar gu Josiiyas pai' gu Koniias gu mar gu Joakim gu Nabukodonosor gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' gu oidha' gu Judaa.
Ba' jix aa' gu' cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu' tu duukam tu' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jeremiiyas.

Jano' ba' bhañ gu gɨ'kora' gu Sedekîas gu Jukal gu mar gu Selemiias gu Sepaniias gu mar gu Maasiias jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan na ba' tu ñi'ook jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jeremiiyas; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jano' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm no'ch gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Jeremiiyas guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios busaak tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam; na gu' cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu vaak kuupa'.

Jano' ba' na ja'p ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Faraoon ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Ejipto suudai' u'va guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm maatɨt gu Kaldeos ko'kmarak mia'n gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jeremiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan bham.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa bhañ tu' na ba' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Faraoon ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Kaldeos guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ dhi' kiicham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tai.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu i'ii'ñ bham; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Kaldeos guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios no'ch; na gu' cham guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' gui'p chiñia' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jano' dhi' gu chio'ñ; na gu' dhi' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu noobh gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ dhi' kiicham gu noobh bɨx gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ñi'ook; na gu' dhi' gu chio'ñ cham tu jiim bhai'x i'ii'ñ dhi' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham bhai'.

Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu Ebed-melek gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jeremiiyas guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam kua' daakat gu gɨ'kora' ki'ñgob gu Benjamiin.
